title: Absences & credits
policy: Cancel at least {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} before a lesson to get a makeup credit. Credits are valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
policyZero: Cancel any time before a lesson starts to get a makeup credit. Credits are valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.

cutoff.before: Cancel by {dateTime} to get a makeup credit.
cutoff.beforeZero: Cancel any time before the lesson starts to get a makeup credit.
cutoff.after: It's after the cutoff ({dateTime}). You can still cancel, but you won't get a credit.

cancel.title: Cancel {group}?
cancel.creditInfo: You'll get a makeup credit, valid until {date}. Use it to join another {level} lesson.
cancel.creditInfoOneOnOne: You'll get a credit to reschedule this lesson with {teacher}, valid until {date}.
cancel.noCreditWarning: It's less than {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} before the lesson, so you won't get a makeup credit. Your teacher will still know you're not coming.
cancel.noCreditWarningZero: The lesson is about to start, so you won't get a makeup credit. Your teacher will still know you're not coming.
cancel.oneOnOneLate: Your teacher keeps this time for you, so the lesson counts as taken.
cancel.final: You can't undo this yourself. If you change your mind, contact the school office.
cancel.doneWithCredit: Lesson cancelled. You have a makeup credit until {date}.
cancel.doneNoCredit: Lesson cancelled. No credit, because it was after the cutoff.
cancel.cutoffPassed: The cutoff passed while you were deciding. You can still cancel, but without a credit.
cancel.started: This lesson has already started, so it can't be cancelled.

byOffice: The school office cancelled this lesson for you on {date}.
noCreditLate: No credit — cancelled after the cutoff.
changedMind: Changed your mind? Contact the school office.

empty.title: No absences
empty.description: If you can't come to a lesson, tap Can't attend? on it in your timetable. Cancel in time and you'll get a credit to make it up.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Only the student or the school office can cancel a lesson.
errors.LESSON_STARTED: This lesson has already started, so it can't be cancelled.
errors.REPLACEMENT_BOOKING: You're joining this lesson as a replacement. Cancel the booking instead.
errors.ALREADY_REPORTED: This lesson has already been cancelled for this student.
errors.ABSENCE_CREDIT_USED: The credit from this absence is already used. Reject that replacement or cancel the rescheduled lesson first.
errors.NOT_A_MEMBER: The student isn't in this lesson's group.
